_comments: Futures-option root registry seed. Loaded by Common/Securities/FutureOption/FutureOptionsRootRegistry.cs.
Section 1: legacy monthly/standard roots - exact copy of the retired hardcoded dictionary in
FuturesOptionsSymbolMappings (_futureToFutureOptionsGLOBEX). cycle=Standard (Monthly|Quarterly),
rule ids 'legacy' = the existing hardcoded FuturesOptionsExpiryFunctions/FuturesOptionsUnderlyingMapper rules.
listedSince 1900-01-01 = predates any data LEAN models; do not filter.
Section 2: hand-written weekly/EOM roots for the 4 pilot products (ES, CL, GC, ZN).
expiryRuleId 'nth_weekday' and 'last_business_day' are forward references to the P2 expiry-rule engine.
underlyingRuleId values (NextQuarterly, FrontMonthly, NearestActiveMonth, NextQuarterlyTreasury) are
forward references to the P3 underlying-mapper extension, per design_A_architecture.md section 3.
ES root conventions verified against CME 'Standard, E-mini, and Micro E-mini S&P 500 Options' Bloomberg
cheat sheet and CME es-options-product-codes-and-listing-calendar.pdf (July 2026): Friday weeklies
EW1-EW4 (weeks 1-4), EOM=EW, Monday=E1A-E5A, Tuesday=E1B-E5B, Wednesday=E1C-E5C, Thursday=E1D-E5D.
ES has no separate daily-option roots: daily expiries are provided by the weekday weekly series.
ZN Friday (ZN1-ZN5) and Wednesday (WY1-WY5) roots verified against CME FAQ 'New Treasury options for
each day of the week' (example Globex symbols WY2N53 and ZN2N5). CL LO1-LO5 and GC OG1-OG5 are the
long-established CME weekly Friday roots (CME Weekly Energy Options / Gold Weekly options pages);
also exercised by the D1 strike audit (DECISIONS.md).
listedSince values are approximate launch years (day precision not required for P1); to be replaced
by earliest-observed-instrument dates from the P5 secdef/Databento generator.
P2 updates: (1) expiryRuleId 'underlying_future' marks the 9 roots (OEH, HCO, OH, PAO, PO, OB,
OYG, OZG, OZI) that are in the legacy mapping dictionary but have no entry in the legacy expiry
table; upstream they resolved through the silent fallback to the underlying future's expiry.
The registry declares that fallback explicitly so the P2 strict unknown-root throw (design B
issue 7) does not change their behavior. Their true CME expiry rules are a P5 work item.
(2) Identity standard roots (NQ, EMD, LE, HE, LBR, LBS, 6N, 6M, EAD, AJY, ANE, ECD) added: these
products have entries in the legacy expiry table keyed by their future ticker (no mapping entry
existed, the option root equals the future root). Registered so MapAll/TryGetDefinition are
complete; expiry still resolves through the legacy hardcoded table.
_comments_p6: P6 updates: per-root settlement semantics (exerciseStyle, expiryTimeOfDay, settlementMarkTime,
settlementTimeZone; exchange-local times). ES weeklies/EOM = EUROPEAN, 3:00pm CT fixing (VERIFIED,
CME Weekly & EOM options FAQ: 30-second VWAP to 3:00pm CT, contrary instructions prohibited).
ES standard root = quarterly semantics: American, AM SOQ 8:30am CT (VERIFIED American via CME equity
options exercise-style table; SOQ time standard). LIMITATION: serial-month ES options share this root
and are approximated with quarterly 8:30am semantics - per-month override is a P5 registry work item.
ZN weeklies = AMERICAN (VERIFIED, CME lists Treasury options among American-style exceptions), marked
against the underlying future at 2:00pm CT on expiry (VERIFIED for Mon-Thu weeklies via CME Interest
Rate Options Expirations article; ASSUMED for Friday ZN1-ZN5, aligned to the 2:00pm convention).
GC weeklies = settlement mark 12:30pm CT = 1:30pm ET gold daily settlement (VERIFIED via COMEX metals
weekly options FAQ); exercise style American ASSUMED (family default), termination time ASSUMED 12:30pm CT.
CL weeklies = AMERICAN (VERIFIED, NYMEX crude options family); mark 1:30pm CT = 2:30pm ET energy daily
settlement window ASSUMED per design_B issue 5. Standard roots other than ES carry no settlement
metadata in P6: they keep the legacy DefaultExerciseModel semantics byte-identical.
_comments_p5lite: P5-lite updates (2026-07-12, pilot validation): weekly roots for NQ/ZN/ZB/GC/CL weekday
series added from the Databento ALL_SYMBOLS definition enumeration (snapshots 2012-07-09,
ZN/ZB Monday=VY/VB, Tuesday=GY/GB, Wednesday=WY/WB, Thursday=HY/HB, Friday=ZN#/ZB#;
GC weekday weeklies G<week><M|T|W|R>; CL ML/NL/WL/XL; NQ Q<week><A|B|C|D> + QN1-4 + QNE.
Weeks not visible in the snapshots (exchange lists ~3 weeks ahead) are inferred from the
family pattern. Retired/ambiguous codes NOT registered (flagged for P5): CL C06-C16 (pre-2016
weekday codes), LM1-5, ICD, LCE; GC L09-L16 (2012-era weekday codes); note VB was a 6B root
in 2012 and is gated by listedSince to the ZB era. Settlement metadata for the new roots is
family-pattern ASSUMED (equity-index European 15:00 CT, treasury American 14:00 CT, gold
12:30 CT, crude 13:30 CT) pending P5 verification.

roots._comment: Identity root: ES standard options carry the future's own root, so the legacy dictionary had no entry (Map fell through to the ticker). Made explicit so MapAll returns the standard root.
Identity standard roots (P2): products with legacy expiry-table entries under their future ticker but no mapping-dictionary entry. See _comments.

Feeder Cattle: identity root with no legacy expiry-table entry. CME GF options terminate with the underlying future (last Thursday of the contract month), so the historical fallback value was correct; declared explicitly. Exercised by upstream DataDownloadConfigTests (GFH6 C368.5).
